items.title: Should investors play AI bottlenecks over social media stocks?
items.summary: Should investors bet more on the AI infrastructure bottlenecks than on other tech trends, such as social media? Today's Market Hang panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi, Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski, Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick, and Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management CEO Ross Gerber.

items.title: The return of the AI rally: What's fueling the latest push into tech?
items.summary: Leading AI stocks ripped higher to kick off this trading week as investors pile back into Big Tech. The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley weigh in on the market breadth of the equities participating in this latest rally.

items.title: Shopify Stock Jumps on Meta Muse Deal: Time to Buy?
items.summary: Shopify (SHOP) shares jumped 7% on Tuesday after announcing a partnership with Meta Platforms (META) that will bring Shop Pay checkout capabilities to Meta's fast-growing Muse AI agent.

items.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Stock Moves 1.34%: What You Should Know
items.summary: In the closing of the recent trading day, Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stood at $623.77, denoting a +1.34% move from the preceding trading day.

items.title: AI Stocks Can’t Carry the Entire Market Forever
items.summary: The artificial-intelligence trade is ripping once again, with tech stocks cresting fresh all-time highs, Wall Street bosses touting the scale of the investment race, and key players in the ecosystem downplaying existential risks from the world’s most important technology.  Comments from JPMorgan’s Jamie Dimon on AI spending, pushback from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on AI risks, and surge in popularity of  Meta Platform  new AI agent Muse have all played a role in the tech resurgence.

items.title: Sandisk, Lennar, Viking Therapeutics, Shopify, GameStop, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Sandisk rises. Rosenblatt initiates coverage of the stock with a Buy rating and a price target of $2,400.

items.title: AMD Stock Has Blown Past Nvidia This Year. Is It Still the Better Buy?
items.summary: Chip stocks have been doing well in recent years due to artificial intelligence (AI), and while Nvidia has typically outperformed AMD, the tide has turned over the past year.

items.title: 12 S&P 500 Stocks Join Trillion-Dollar Club — What Could Go Wrong?
items.summary: It was big news when the value of Apple surpassed $1 trillion. But now a dozen S&P 500 companies have done it.
